verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a Create Event endpoint that tracks a specific profile's activity and creates or updates that profile, accepting arbitrary schema-less data (klaviyo-docs-30, klaviyo-docs-43, klaviyo-docs-24). The docs also state that merchants can set up flows based on Klaviyo events (klaviyo-docs-17), and a community user describes tagging custom events and acting on them with automated emails (klaviyo-comm-2). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configuring a custom-metric flow trigger and its per-profile targeting semantics, and recent independent hands-on corroboration (the community evidence is old).
